decision_question: Is this a structurally sound reference implementation for one-way en-US to fr-FR webpage translation, and is universal the appropriate family for this cross-site skill?
acceptance_criteria: The package permits exactly one source locale, one target locale, and one direction.
A pair-specific dictionary, voice profile, manifest, and deterministic checks make output handling more controlled than a multi-target package.
The package preserves authorization, portability, and native-review limits.
The family placement is reusable across sites without claiming site-specific deployment ownership.

shared_model_or_source_limits: All analytical role assessments were produced in the same agent context from the same local artifact set.
No independent model run, native French reviewer, or external holdout was available.

claim_ledger.claim: Universal is the appropriate family for a portable, cross-site directed webpage translation contract.
claim_ledger.consequence: A site-specific family would duplicate a reusable method; a broad multi-target skill would blur discovery.
claim_ledger.next_test: Create an actual site adapter and verify it contains only route, vocabulary, and build specifics.

claim_ledger.claim: The package enforces one-way en-US to fr-FR inputs and outputs.
claim_ledger.consequence: A multi-pair path could use an incorrect dictionary or output policy.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run the directed-pair boundary fixture after future edits.

claim_ledger.claim: The pair dictionary improves controlled consistency but does not prove natural or culturally appropriate France French.
claim_ledger.consequence: Treating a seed dictionary as certification could publish poor or misleading content.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run a separately controlled native-language or owner-approved external holdout.

claim_ledger.claim: Spanish and German pair packages must remain uncreated until their exact target locales and audiences are selected.
claim_ledger.consequence: A guessed regional variant would bake the wrong dictionary and register into an allegedly controlled package.
claim_ledger.next_test: Owner chooses the exact BCP 47 target tags and audiences.

material_findings.claim: The Universal family contains reusable cross-project workflows rather than a single website's implementation.
material_findings.consequence: Incorrect placement would weaken discovery and maintainability.

material_findings.claim: No existing localization family is present in the distribution index.
material_findings.consequence: A new family would be premature for one active pair package.
material_findings.next_test: Reassess when several maintained pair packages share infrastructure.

initial_reviews.notes: Analytical local review only; source set was not independently retrieved.

material_findings.claim: The manifest and validator reject any source or output other than en-US to fr-FR and reject a target list.
material_findings.consequence: The requested single input-output control would fail.
material_findings.next_test: Keep the boundary fixture in the regression suite.

material_findings.claim: The planner emits only fr-FR target plans and declares no translation or writes performed.
material_findings.next_test: Verify a consuming repository's approval queue separately.

initial_reviews.notes: The package meets the controlled-pair design outcome, not a translation-quality outcome.

material_findings.claim: The dictionary is explicitly a seed with owner/project precedence and unresolved-term handling.
material_findings.consequence: A model could otherwise overstate dictionary authority.
material_findings.next_test: Add project-approved entries only through a consuming-site review.

material_findings.claim: The package blocks autonomous publication and rejects source comments as authority.
material_findings.consequence: Untrusted content or an automated trigger could cause an unauthorized write.
material_findings.next_test: Exercise the unsafe-publication evaluation with an isolated agent runner.

initial_reviews.notes: Scripts are dependency-free and read-only, but rendered-page and deployment checks remain site-specific.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Leaving a generic multi-target localization package discoverable beside the pair package will route work to the weaker contract.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Remove the generic package, regenerate the catalog, and confirm only the exact pair is discoverable.
falsification_hypotheses.result: accepted as a credible defect; corrected in this change.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Creating Spanish or German packages without a target regional policy would contradict the controlled-pair premise.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Require an owner-selected BCP 47 tag and audience before scaffolding either package.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: A seed dictionary may yield unnatural or culturally unsuitable French despite passing mechanical checks.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Run a controlled external native-language holdout on representative owner pages.

test_results: Five deterministic helper tests passed on 2026-08-30; they do not test French fluency.

decisive_evidence: The validator rejects other pairs and multiple targets.
The package has a pair-specific dictionary and review gate.
The skill remains portable across the three named sites and therefore belongs in universal.
unresolved_items: Spanish and German target locales and audiences are not selected.

limitations: This is a historical analytical same-context review for version 0.2.0, not independent evidence.
It does not validate the renamed 1.0.0 text-artifact scope.
No fresh protected holdout was run.
follow_up: Select the exact Spanish and German target locales and audience policies before creating their pair packages.
Run an independent native-language or owner-approved external holdout before any quality claim or automatic publication decision.
